package com.spoopdps;

import java.util.HashSet;
import java.util.Set;
import net.runelite.api.gameval.NpcID;

final class BossNpcIds
{
	private static final Set<Integer> BOSSES = buildBossSet();

	private BossNpcIds()
	{
	}

	static boolean isBoss(int npcId)
	{
		return BOSSES.contains(npcId);
	}

	private static Set<Integer> buildBossSet()
	{

			NpcID.ABYSSALSIRE_SIRE_STASIS_SLEEPING, NpcID.ABYSSALSIRE_SIRE_STASIS_AWAKE, NpcID.ABYSSALSIRE_SIRE_STASIS_STUNNED,

			NpcID.OLM_HEAD_SPAWNING, NpcID.OLM_HAND_LEFT_SPAWNING, NpcID.OLM_HAND_RIGHT, NpcID.OLM_HEAD, NpcID.OLM_HAND_LEFT,

			NpcID.RAIDS_LIZARDSHAMAN_A, NpcID.RAIDS_LIZARDSHAMAN_B,
			NpcID.RAIDS_ICEDEMON_NONCOMBAT, NpcID.RAIDS_ICEDEMON_COMBAT,
			NpcID.RAIDS_SKELETONMYSTIC_A, NpcID.RAIDS_SKELETONMYSTIC_B, NpcID.RAIDS_SKELETONMYSTIC_C
		);
		return bosses;
	}

	private static void addAll(Set<Integer> set, int... ids)
	{
		for (int id : ids)
		{
			set.add(id);
		}
	}
}
